title: Alex Hormozi Asks A Fat Guy Why He Isn't 200 Pounds Heavier. He's Right.
hook: Alex Hormozi asked a guy who can't stop eating why he isn't 200 pounds heavier, and he's right.
body: You already know how to stop eating, you just stop at the wrong point. A caller on The Iced Coffee Hour told Alex Hormozi he can't stop eating, and Hormozi asked him why he isn't 200 pounds heavier. This is a critical insight most Hormozi fans haven't seen: you already stop somewhere, your stopping point is just set too high. Here's how to set it with a number, by weighing yourself every morning and cutting back the day you're 2 pounds over. And if you need help stopping at a healthy point, Zepbound can make that easy.
